Subject: Need help with a wrongful termination case

Hello, my name is Anjali Rao. I am a 63-year-old railway employee living in Surat. My employer Karve Industries owes me ₹51,50,000 after firing me, and the employer withheld the last salary. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on +91 96797 09975 or email anjali.rao@example.com.
